baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal sequence 'when we heard the guidance, we trusted it' at words 3-6.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hearing functions as understanding and compliance; it receives guidance as gentle route-indication and immediately becomes trusting assent.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance turns hearing from acoustic contact into enacted reception.
Gentle indication toward a way or truth supplies the content and direction received.
Trusting assent makes faith the completed response to understood guidance.

changed_reading.before: They acoustically heard a message and then adopted a belief.
changed_reading.after: They understood and accepted a gently indicated course, so hearing itself crossed into trusting commitment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated faith root, 'in his Lord,' and 'does not fear' at words 5, 8-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trust settles the heart under a Lord whose branch image includes staged nurture and completion; that relation displaces anticipatory fear of harm.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supplies the believer's relational posture.
Repair, nurture, and completion makes the Lord the agent who carries the person through a process.
Fearful anticipation of harm names the prospective state canceled by that trust.

changed_reading.before: Belief earns an unspecified promise of safety.
changed_reading.after: Entrusting oneself to the Lord's completing care relocates security before the feared outcome arrives.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compact pair 'no diminution and no oppressive burden' at words 11-14.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause bounds harm in two directions: nothing due is shaved away, and no crushing excess is imposed. A diminution branch inside fear itself tightens the first side of the pairing.

activation_trace.role: Diminishing by taking away lets the fear-word echo the loss named immediately after it.
Diminishing what is due defines the subtractive boundary of the assurance.
Coercive burdening defines the additive boundary: no load beyond capacity is forced on the believer.

changed_reading.before: The believer need not fear two roughly synonymous harms.
changed_reading.after: The believer is promised bounded justice: neither under-crediting nor oppressive overloading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context identifies the heard object as recitation, marks it as frame-breaking, and immediately renders its guidance as sound practical judgment. The focus verse is therefore a compressed communal reorientation, not merely a report of exposure followed by assent.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance keeps the focus hearing anchored as responsive reception.
Gentle route-indication anchors what the focus audience recognizes in what it hears.
Trusting assent supplies the focus response produced by that recognition.
Reading and recitation identifies the acoustic event as articulated transmission rather than ambient sound.
Wonder at an unfamiliar matter supplies the disruption that opens their prior frame to revision.
Hitting the right face of an affair and acting soundly specifies the guidance's practical yield.

structural_cues: The plural group report in 72:1-2 expands the same hear-guidance-believe sequence compressed in 72:13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, unfamiliarity, and sound judgment; I infer that unfamiliar recitation interrupts an inherited frame and that understood direction, not novelty alone, produces assent. A live alternative is a simple chronological report with no reclassification mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus records an individual's generic conversion after hearing.
changed_reading.after: A community hears a recited discourse, recognizes in its strangeness a workable right course, and collectively changes allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opposes two path mechanics: guidance gently indicates a route, while turning away results in being inserted into an arduous ascent. The focus's freedom from oppressive burden is thus freedom from coerced routing, not freedom from all movement or effort.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a route anchors the noncoercive side of the focus reading.
Coercive burdening anchors the load that the focus explicitly negates.
Gentle route-indication makes the earlier description of guidance the positive path operator.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the coercive directional action on the one who turns away.
An arduous ascent gives the inserted route the shape of sustained difficulty.

structural_cues: The guidance-to-right-course sequence in 72:2 and the turning-away-to-ascent sequence in 72:17 run as inverse trajectories.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gentle guidance, insertion, and a difficult ascent; I infer that manner of routing distinguishes care from burden. The live alternative is that 72:17 describes punishment only, without illuminating the focus's use of oppressive load.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is information, and absence of oppressive burden means generic ease.
changed_reading.after: Guidance offers a traversable direction, while rejection yields forced passage into difficulty; the assurance concerns agency and load, not effortless life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier human recourse to jinn as protectors increases the exact burden later negated. The focus relocates trust to one's Lord, reversing a protection arrangement that manufactures the danger it claims to solve.

activation_trace.role: Settled trust supplies the replacement posture after the failed refuge relation.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identifies the proper protection relation.
Coercive burdening names the outcome that proper trust no longer generates.
Seeking refuge and protection supplies the earlier social dependency being tested.
Increase and growth supplies the explicit causal escalation produced by that dependency.
Coercive burdening identifies what the false shelter relation increases.

structural_cues: The exact term for oppressive burden occurs positively as an increased result in 72:6 and negatively after faith in the Lord in 72:13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refuge, an increase arrow, and repeated oppressive burden; I infer that the chosen protector is the causal hinge between escalation and security. A live alternative is that the earlier burden is only moral transgression rather than a self-reinforcing patronage relation.

changed_reading.before: Inward belief gives private reassurance against fear.
changed_reading.after: Faith transfers reliance away from exploitative intermediaries to the Lord and thereby breaks a burden-producing protection system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same surah contrasts listeners stationed to intercept hearing under watch with a chosen messenger whose route is threaded through watch. The focus hearing becomes authenticated reception within a guarded chain, not success at extracting inaccessible information.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance anchors the focus as receptive hearing rather than mere acquisition.
Gentle route-indication marks the received content as guidance rather than intercepted data.
Sitting for surveillance supplies the posture of deliberate interception.
Ear-hearing supplies the literal access sought at the former listening stations.
Watchful guarding blocks the extractive listening route.
Approval rather than displeasure supplies selection at the head of the authorized route.
Messenger and message identifies the authorized carrier and transmitted content.
Threading one thing through another supplies a controlled transmission corridor.

structural_cues: The repeated watch term at 72:9 and 72:27 reverses function: it confronts an unauthorized listener and surrounds a selected messenger route.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interception stations, blocking watch, selection, messenger, and routed watch; I infer an authentication contrast that explains why the focus hearing transforms. A live alternative is that both watches are only surveillance and do not certify transmission.

changed_reading.before: Hearing guidance is simply successful access to hidden information.
changed_reading.after: The decisive hearing is receptive participation in an authorized message chain, sharply distinguished from extractive eavesdropping.

context_deltas.mechanism: A distributive share image, abundant water, immediate assay, and terminal exhaustive counting separate just preservation from uninterrupted prosperity. 'No diminution' concerns a due share that remains intact through testing and complete accounting, not a promise that material abundance itself is never dangerous.

activation_trace.role: Diminishing what is due anchors the focus assurance as preservation of a rightful share.
Share and division supplies a distributive register adjacent to the focus's due-loss language.
A share and channel of irrigation makes provision both allotted and materially conveyed.
Abundant water and provision supplies the apparent prosperity whose function is then revised.
Assaying metal or a person turns abundance into a test of disclosed quality.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and custody supplies the audit's total scope.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies the operation that prevents an unnoticed shortfall.
Counting what is countable closes the surah with an explicit ledger image.

structural_cues: 72:16's abundant water is immediately subordinated to testing in 72:17, while 72:28 closes with encompassing and exhaustive count.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allotted share, abundance, assay, custody, and counting; I infer that the focus's no-shortfall promise has an accounting horizon that survives prosperity and trial. A live alternative is that diminution refers only to recompense and has no distributive analogy in present provision.

changed_reading.before: No diminution means believers should expect undiminished worldly provision.
changed_reading.after: Even abundance can be an assay; the assurance is that no due value disappears from the Lord's fully encompassing account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker disclaims ownership of harm and right direction, cannot place even himself under independent protection, and retains only delivery. The focus's faith 'in it' and 'in his Lord' therefore does not transfer protective agency to the human messenger.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent anchors the response to the delivered guidance.
Lordship and authority identifies where protective agency remains.
Ownership and power of disposal supplies the capacity explicitly disclaimed by the speaker.
Harm and deficiency names one outcome the speaker does not control.
Soundly hitting the right course names the positive outcome the speaker likewise does not own.
Protective neighborhood and safe-conduct supplies the shelter no independent party can grant against God.
Conveying a message bounds the messenger's actual function after ownership and shelter are denied.

structural_cues: The first-person disclaimers in 72:21-23 follow the community's testimony and distinguish the messenger's delivery from the Lord's agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disowned control over harm and right direction, denied independent shelter, and retained delivery; I infer that the two pronoun-relations in the focus separate message reception from ultimate reliance. A live alternative is that both relations are compressed without intending a formal agency distinction.

changed_reading.before: The hearers' faith may be allegiance to the charismatic bearer of guidance.
changed_reading.after: They assent to the delivered guidance while entrusting protection and outcome only to their Lord; the bearer transmits but does not own either.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر ب ب mapping into the r-b-w branch of usurious surplus rather than replacing the dominant Lord sense. It remains anchored to 'his Lord,' diminution, and oppressive burden as a cross-domain relational analogy. Downstream prose should label it an economic shadow-model, never a lexical gloss of rabb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of 'his Lord' with no diminution and no oppressive burden at words 9-14.

activation_trace.role: Usurious surplus in a transaction supplies an excessive-charge shadow beside the dominant Lord relation.
Diminishing a due right supplies the under-crediting side of the economic analogy.
Coercive loading supplies the overcharging side of the economic analogy.

changed_reading.before: The assurance names two undifferentiated harms under divine protection.
changed_reading.after: As a contained account analogy, the Lord-relation guarantees neither a shaved credit nor a compounding burden imposed on the believer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ه د ي mapping into h-d-d images of collapse and crash. It remains anchored to the focus guidance and hearing, while the closed, fiery listening boundary supplies a contextual rupture. Downstream prose should render it only as an image of an old epistemic structure breaking, not as the meaning of huda.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The heard guidance at words 3-4 as the event immediately preceding changed trust.

activation_trace.role: Literal hearing keeps the speculative rupture attached to an acoustic event in the focus.
Severe breaking and collapse supplies the image of a prior interpretive structure giving way.
A loud crash supplies the form-distant acoustic force of that epistemic break.
A bright flame supplies the newly manifest boundary around former modes of listening.
Watchful guarding makes the old access pattern visibly untenable.

changed_reading.before: Guidance gently adds correct information to an intact worldview.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root image, what they hear also crashes through and demolishes the listening regime by which they formerly knew.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The material analogy is surprising because it places the focus's overwhelming cover beside a crowd described through matter felting layer over layer. It remains anchored to the negated oppressive covering and to the later caller physically surrounded. Downstream prose should say that dense social pressure need not become inward or juridical overwhelm, not deny the crowding itself.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negation of overwhelming burden at word 14.

activation_trace.role: Settled security supplies an interior stability that can coexist with exterior pressure.
Covering and overpowering names the condition explicitly denied in the focus.
Matter felting layer upon layer gives the surrounding crowd a concrete compression image.
A dense multitude piled one over another translates material compression into social pressure.

changed_reading.before: No oppressive covering implies the faithful will not be physically crowded or pressured.
changed_reading.after: The faithful caller may be densely surrounded, yet the crowd's felt-like pressure need not become the overpowering burden negated by trust.

strongest_changes: The exact burden increased by misplaced refuge in 72:6 is negated when trust is relocated to the Lord in 72:13.
Repeated watching distinguishes extractive interception from selected, guarded transmission, changing what counts as transformative hearing.
Abundance followed by assay and exhaustive counting moves no-diminution from a prosperity promise to preservation within complete accounting.
The messenger's disowned control and retained delivery separate assent to the message from reliance on the Lord.
summary.what_was_special: Exact repetitions created causal reversals, while split-root and material branches exposed economic, acoustic, route, and crowd-pressure models without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The watch around the messenger may indicate surveillance alone rather than authentication of transmission.
The horizon of no diminution and no oppressive burden may be immediate, eschatological, or deliberately span both.
The non-dominant ر ب ب and ه د ي mappings remain analogical outliers and must not displace their dominant focus senses.
